name: Image Studio
intro: Image Studio is where you create AI images from a text description, or transform photos you upload, all from one prompt bar.

features.text-to-image: Type what you want into the prompt bar and generate. It's the fastest way to create something from nothing, and a sentence is enough to begin.
features.image-to-image-reference-images: Add a reference image with the picker, the Pexels button or the attachment toolbar. The studio switches to image-to-image, so you can restyle or transform a photo.
features.model-picker: The model picker opens a searchable list grouped by provider. Different models suit speed, photorealism, text inside images or anime, so try a few.
features.aspect-ratio-and-resolution: Aspect Ratio matches the picture to where it's used, like nine by sixteen for stories. Resolution appears only for models that offer quality options.
features.advanced-panel: The Advanced panel adds a Style Preset, Batch Count and model-specific controls, such as a seed for repeatable results.
features.tools-panel-quick-starters-and-prompt-en: The Tools button opens Quick Starters and a Prompt Enhancer. They help beginners write richer prompts, with one click to use them in the generator.
features.draw-sketch-a-reference: Draw opens a sketch pad. Rough out shapes to control the composition, then add your sketch as a reference for the model to follow.
features.result-canvas-history-and-publish: After generating, the result canvas offers Regenerate, Download and Publish to Social. The History strip keeps earlier images to restore, download or delete.

outro: That's Image Studio. Be specific, change one thing at a time, and use Regenerate to explore variations until the image feels right.
